name: Ast
fix_description: In _transfer, remove the _burn(from, amount) call when checkLiquidityRm returns true. Burning tokens directly from the pair during transfer allows attackers to manipulate the pair price by triggering the liquidity removal detection falsely.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step exploit involving two flash swaps, manipulation of an ELP exchange’s internal-vs-actual balance accounting, liquidity add/remove sequencing, and a final reserve-based swap. It requires understanding protocol-specific AMM logic and cross-contract interactions, but the attack flow is still relatively compact and not deeply stateful enough to be hard.
